type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: feat(c12): include structural progress coverage gate
feat(c12): close structural progress coverage by fixing a present variable
fix(c11): close eraseDups boolean cases and normalize disjunctions
fix(c11): prove eraseDups invariants on Lean 4.19 and normalize simplifier
fix(c11): factor simplifier membership lemmas and import List proofs
feat(c11): prove free-variable monotonicity under restriction and simplification

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.eraseDups_length_le_of_subset
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List Nat}, l₁ ⊆ l₂ → l₁.eraseDups.length ≤ l₂.eraseDups.length

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.eraseDups_loop_mem_nat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (x : Nat) (as bs : List Nat), x ∈ List.eraseDups.loop as bs ↔ x ∈ as ∨ x ∈ bs

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.eraseDups_loop_nodup_nat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (as bs : List Nat), bs.Nodup → (List.eraseDups.loop as bs).Nodup

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.eraseDups_nodup_nat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (l : List Nat), l.eraseDups.Nodup

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_eraseDups_nat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} {l : List Nat}, x ∈ l.eraseDups ↔ x ∈ l

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_D
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} (ρ : MCore.CircuitK1.Restriction) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.C9.D ρ t) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_reduceAnd
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} {d e : MCore.C9.FormulaTree},   x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.C11.reduceAnd d e) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList d ∨ x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_reduceNot
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} {d : MCore.C9.FormulaTree}, x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.C11.reduceNot d) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList d

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_reduceOr
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} {d e : MCore.C9.FormulaTree},   x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.C11.reduceOr d e) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList d ∨ x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_restrict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} (ρ : MCore.CircuitK1.Restriction) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.CircuitK1.restrict ρ t) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.mem_freeVarList_simplify
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {x : Nat} (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify t) → x ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.nodup_length_le_of_subset_nat
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List Nat}, l₁.Nodup → l₂.Nodup → l₁ ⊆ l₂ → l₁.length ≤ l₂.length

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.restrictionProgress_of_strict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (ρ : MCore.CircuitK1.Restriction) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   MCore.C11.StrictRestrictionProgress ρ t → MCore.C10.RestrictionProgress ρ t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.simplify_and_eq
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (a b : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   MCore.CircuitC2.simplify (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.and a b) =     MCore.C11.reduceAnd (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify a) (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.simplify_not_eq
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (c : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   MCore.CircuitC2.simplify (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.not c) = MCore.C11.reduceNot (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify c)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.simplify_or_eq
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (a b : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   MCore.CircuitC2.simplify (MCore.CircuitK1.Circuit.or a b) =     MCore.C11.reduceOr (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify a) (MCore.CircuitC2.simplify b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.stateRank_D_decreases_of_strict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (ρ : MCore.CircuitK1.Restriction) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   MCore.C11.StrictRestrictionProgress ρ t → MCore.C9.stateRank (MCore.C9.D ρ t) < MCore.C9.stateRank t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.varsNonincrease_closed
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: MCore.C10.VarsNonincreaseObligation

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C11.vars_D_le
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (ρ : MCore.CircuitK1.Restriction) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree), MCore.C9.vars (MCore.C9.D ρ t) ≤ MCore.C9.vars t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.eraseDups_length_lt_of_subset_of_missing
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List Nat} {i : Nat}, l₁ ⊆ l₂ → i ∈ l₂ → ¬i ∈ l₁ → l₁.eraseDups.length < l₂.eraseDups.length

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.exists_freeVar_of_vars_pos
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree), 0 < MCore.C9.vars t → ∃ i, i ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.exists_rank_decreasing_restriction
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree), 0 < MCore.C9.vars t → ∃ ρ, MCore.C9.stateRank (MCore.C9.D ρ t) < MCore.C9.stateRank t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.fixVarTrue_ne
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {i j : Nat}, j ≠ i → MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i j = none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.fixVarTrue_self
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (i : Nat), MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i i = some true

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.fixedVar_not_mem_D
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (i : Nat) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree), ¬i ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.C9.D (MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i) t)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.fixedVar_not_mem_restrict
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (i : Nat) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree), ¬i ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList (MCore.CircuitK1.restrict (MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i) t)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.progressCoverage_closed
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: MCore.C10.ProgressCoverageObligation

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.strictProgress_fix_present
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (i : Nat) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   i ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t → MCore.C11.StrictRestrictionProgress (MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i) t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.C12.vars_D_lt_fixVarTrue
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (i : Nat) (t : MCore.C9.FormulaTree),   i ∈ MCore.C9.freeVarList t → MCore.C9.vars (MCore.C9.D (MCore.C12.fixVarTrue i) t) < MCore.C9.vars t
